lemma harvested (H : S.Hierarchy) (h : F.Ordered C S) (a : (Bel C.book).RealSpin)
    (X : Station C D) {N : ℕ} {R ε : ℝ} (hs : X.Admissible F a N R ε) :
    ∃ U : Panel S,
      (∀ d≤D, StraightAt H.spin a U d) ∧ U 0 ((Bel C.book).unit 0)=S.unit 0 ∧
      ∀ (n : ℕ), n ≤ N → ∀ v : Fin n → (Bel C.book).Tag, (∀ i,(v i).1 ≤ D) →
        ∀ t : Test n, tsupport t ⊆ Scaling.window R n →
        ∀ M : ℝ, 0 < M → (∀ x, ‖t x‖ ≤ M) →
        ‖t.applyTo (tested X.r U v) - t.applyTo (disc v)‖ ≤ ε * Station.charge v * M := by

proof_context.conclusion: From bounded lifts at a station, `harvested` produces a `Panel S` of linear maps, unital and eventually `StraightAt`, satisfying the tested error bound for every tuple and test.

structure Approaches (R : Zoom) (U : ℕ → Panel S) : Prop where
  values (n : ℕ) (v : Fin n → (Bel C.book).Tag) : Fades (fun k => tested (R.r k) (U k) v - disc v)

proof_context.conclusion: `Approaches`: the tested difference fades for every finite tuple.
